source_quote: Infrastructure 8.1 (Production Branch) - Released May 2026, this Production Branch (PB) includes GPU Driver 595.71.05, NVIDIA Virtual GPU Manager 595.71.03 and vGPU for Compute Guest Driver (Linux 595.71.05 / Windows 596.36), NVIDIA Run:ai 2.25 (self-hosted) plus NVIDIA Run:ai SaaS, NVIDIA DOCA 3.4.0, and updated Kubernetes operators (GPU Operator 26.3.3, Network Operator 26.4.0, DPU Operator (DPF) 26.4.0, NIM Operator 3.1.1) along with NVIDIA Container Toolkit 1.19.1 and Base Command Manager 11.33.1.

Google Deepmind unveils Gemini Robotics 2 to power robots of all shapes from tabletop arms to humanoids

Google Deepmind has introduced Gemini Robotics 2, which it calls its most advanced vision-language-action (VLA) model yet. VLA models combine image recognition, language processing, and action control to help robots operate in physical environments. Deepmind says the model can control systems ranging from tabletop arms to full-body humanoid robots.
